Reuse active 바루파키르, keeping the ship suffix inside the Korean label. The eponymous book is separately registered and takes a complete bilingual title.

English identifies King Maht's royal ship, distinct from the prince's Barufakir; its safe-sea blessing and later transport by golems establish the referent. Japanese ナグルファー号 and Chinese 纳戈法号/纳格尔法号 corroborate. Retain repeated Korean 나글파르호 and annotate each explicit ship name.
